title: Rooftop Snipers
description: Rooftop Snipers is a chaotic two button local multiplayer game. Challenge your friends side by side or play the computer. Shoot your opponent off the map to win.
instructions: Player 1: W to shoot/jump. Player 2: up arrow to shoot/jump. Knock your opponent off the rooftop.
tags: Rooftop Snipers, 2 Player, Sniper, Shooting, Hot, Popular

title: Stickman Hook
description: Stickman Hook is a simple, original and challenging swinging game. Swing your stickman through each level using ropes and momentum.
instructions: Click and hold to swing from a rope, release to fly.
tags: Stickman, Swing, Hook, Physics, Hot, Popular

title: Getaway Shootout
description: Race to the extraction point by jumping! Dodge obstacles, grab weapons, and out-jump the competition in this wild multiplayer game.
instructions: Player 1: A/D to lean, W to jump. Player 2: arrow keys to lean, up to jump. Grab weapons along the way.
tags: Getaway Shootout, 2 Player, Multiplayer, Physics, Hot, Popular

title: 12 MiniBattles
description: A casual two-player game featuring various minigames with 36 uniquely chaotic mini-battles, each with simple one-button controls. Golf, wrestling, axe battle, football, duels and more.

tags: MiniBattles, 2 Player, Multiplayer, Party, Hot, Popular

title: Temple of Boom
description: A fast-paced, retro-styled platform arena shooter. Be the last one standing in the Temple of Boom, solo or against a friend.
instructions: Player 1: WASD to move, F to shoot. Player 2: arrow keys to move, M to shoot.
tags: Temple of Boom, 2 Player, Shooting, Arena, Hot, Popular

title: T-Rex Runner
description: The offline dinosaur runner, open-sourced as its own standalone game. Jump over cacti and duck under birds for as long as you can survive.
instructions: Press Space or Up to jump. Press Down to duck.
tags: T-Rex, Runner, Dinosaur, Open Source, Endless

title: Bloxd.io
description: A whole Minecraft-style multiplayer platform: build, survive, PvP, or jump into dozens of community-made minigames.
instructions: Pick a game mode from the lobby. WASD to move, mouse to look/build, Space to jump.

title: Friday Night Funkin
description: The viral rhythm game. Win the girl over by out-rapping her overprotective, demon-like ex-boyfriend and a colorful cast of rivals.
instructions: Hit the arrow keys in time with the highlighted notes to win the rap battle. Miss too many and you lose.
tags: Friday Night Funkin, FNF, Rhythm, Music, Popular

title: Crossy Road
description: The endless arcade hopper. Guide your character across roads, rivers and train tracks, dodging traffic for as long as you can survive.

tags: Crossy Road, Arcade, Endless, Hopper, Popular

title: 8 Ball Pool
description: Classic billiards. Sink your set of balls before your opponent, then pocket the 8-ball to win. Play vs CPU or a friend on the same device.
instructions: Aim with the mouse, hold to set power, release to shoot. Sink your balls first, then the 8-ball to win.

title: Veck.io
description: Fast-paced multiplayer FPS.io game. Drop into a lobby, pick a loadout and battle other players in real time.

title: Agar.io
description: The original cell-eating multiplayer game. Absorb smaller cells and mass to grow, and avoid anything bigger than you.
instructions: Move the mouse to steer your cell. Press Space to split, W to eject mass.

title: Paper.io 2
description: Claim territory by drawing a trail and closing loops. Cut off rivals' tails before they cut off yours.
instructions: Move the mouse or use arrow keys to steer. Return to your territory to claim the area you've drawn.

title: Shell Shockers
description: A multiplayer FPS where you play as an armed egg. Hatch, grab weapons and crack the competition across classic shooter modes.
instructions: WASD to move, mouse to aim/shoot, Space to jump. Pick a class and mode from the lobby.
tags: Shell Shockers, FPS, Shooter, io Game, Multiplayer

title: Krunker.io
description: A fast, blocky multiplayer FPS that runs entirely in the browser. Pick a class, customize your loadout and battle it out.
instructions: WASD to move, mouse to aim/shoot, Space to jump, Shift to sprint. Pick a class from the loadout menu.
tags: Krunker, FPS, Shooter, io Game, Multiplayer, Popular

title: Starve.io
description: A multiplayer survival game. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, build a base, and survive against other players and the wild.
instructions: WASD to move, click to attack/gather. Craft items from the inventory menu.
tags: Starve.io, Survival, Crafting, io Game, Multiplayer

title: Bonk.io
description: Physics-based multiplayer arena battles. Bump, bounce and knock other players off the map in fast, chaotic rounds.

title: Space Waves
description: A fast-paced arcade flyer. Steer your ship through tight waves of obstacles without crashing, going as far as you can.

title: Table Tennis World Tour
description: Pick your country and compete in table tennis matches on the world stage. Simple controls, real rally physics.
instructions: Drag the mouse to move your paddle and control the shot. Win the rally to score.

title: Garden Bloom

title: Bubble Tower 3D
description: Shoot bubbles to climb the tower. Match colors to clear bubbles and reach the top without running out of space.
instructions: Aim with the mouse, click to shoot a bubble. Match 3 of the same color to pop them.

title: Cannon Balls 3D
description: A physics puzzle game. Aim your cannon and knock down every target on the stage in as few shots as possible.
instructions: Aim with the mouse, click to fire. Clear every target to advance to the next level.

title: Tower Crash 3D
description: Knock down towers of blocks with a wrecking ball. Clear every block on the stage to win.
instructions: Aim with the mouse, click to swing the wrecking ball. Bring down the whole tower.

title: Element Blocks

title: Bubble Woods

description: Test your aim across archery ranges around the world. Hit the bullseye to rack up points.

title: Candy Bubble

instructions: Aim with the mouse, click to shoot a bubble. Match 3 of the same color to pop them.

title: Gold Mine

instructions: Click and drag to swap two adjacent tiles. Match 3 or more of the same kind to clear them.
